narrative.overview:
Member web pairs the owner's wine-red owl and lettering with warm paper, tall display type and colored grounds for complete book covers. Discovery is lively; listing facts and task controls stay direct, readable and quieter than the covers. This records the world built after the owner's replacement decision on 10/10/2026, using the [surface contract](apps/user-web/.impeccable/surfaces/apps-user-web-src-pages-booksearchpage-tsx.md) and [PRODUCT](PRODUCT.md), rather than the superseded green web sketches.

The implemented web slice is Home, Search, Detail, Login, Sell, Account, Register, shared Header/BookCard/ConfirmDialog and MainLayout/DashboardLayout. Login owns its bookstore split with the original logo over the photograph, tactile ivory paper behind the form and a separate paper-side home action, apart from the shared Member Header. Register reuses that scene for an honest unavailable state. Sell owns its paper task desk and five existing steps. Account owns a real owner-listing shelf and read-only identity inside compact personal navigation. Other forms, auction and chat retain legacy page recipes even where the shared shell changes. React Native retains its separate green Be Vietnam Pro system; its source/tests were not changed by this web build. Flutter remains scaffold. These tokens describe implementation, not human acceptance or a closed release gate.

Search refined11/10 uses a compact wine title/search band and paper sidebar catalog with the existing compact cover recipe. Named native draft filters replace the sidebar at900px, with explicit Apply/Reset,44px targets, URL criteria/cursors and page-only counts. DEV preview remains labelled and separate from live API behavior; Search follows global motion reduction.
keyCharacteristics: Wine-and-cream identity with orange, yellow and mint discovery accents.
Anton for expressive headings; Be Vietnam Pro for book facts and actions.
Whole covers on colored grounds; unboxed metadata and separately labelled prices.
Original owner logo and sourced decorative imagery, distinct from listing photographs.
Responsive web recipes and a separately preserved React Native implementation.

rules.name: The Ground Is Not Status Rule
rules.body: Colored cover grounds are decorative; communicate condition, prices and reservation state in real text from the listing.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Anton carries expressive discovery moments; Be Vietnam Pro carries Home category/catalog headings, book titles, prices, forms and consequential actions. Use the bundled weights.

dos: **Do** preserve the owner's original logo pixels and the owl-plus-lettering identity on narrow screens.
**Do** use complete API listing photographs and expose condition, sale price and exchange value with their real labels.
**Do** keep archival and owner-supplied Home covers decorative and visibly captioned, with provenance in the asset READMEs/sidecars.
**Do** use the scoped web tokens for this implemented slice and the incumbent RN tokens for unchanged native screens.
**Do** retain error/empty/loading states, keyboard focus, wrapping titles and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** explain consequential actions in direct Vietnamese, including reservation without payment.
donts: **Don't** substitute stock or archival covers for real listing photographs or invent rating/trust claims.
**Don't** treat alternating cover colors or descriptive condition labels as verification or transaction status.
**Don't** infer that legacy web pages, Android, Flutter or release gates adopted this web redesign.
**Don't** regenerate the supplied logo, imitate its lettering with a font, or treat a reference screenshot as licensed cover assets.
**Don't** canonize legacy glyph-icon, display-font or animation recipes as part of this web world.
